lines: [somber] Before the fall... we called ourselves Guardians.
[reflective] We carried the Light — the last ember of a dying sun.
For a hundred years, we kept watch over the worlds of humankind.
[ominous] Then the Ember Collective came. Not with fleets... but with doors, torn into the sky.
[grave] Earth was the first to fall. Its cities burned from within.
Then Mars... and the long silence between the worlds.
[sorrowful] One by one, the Guardians fell.
And the Light went out of the world.
[quiet] The Vanguard drifted a hundred years... a dead ship on a dark tide.
Its last pilot asleep in the cold.
[hopeful] But a single light was never meant to die. It only waited.
[building] Now, beneath the ash of Earth, something stirs. An Archive.
A memory of how the doors were opened... and how they can be closed, forever.
[awe] The ship is waking. The Light remembers your name.
